dog.description_text:
Introducing Chi Chi, a little kitten with a big heart and an even bigger personality!

Chi Chi is the kind of kitten who makes herself impossible to forget. Found as a stray with her littermates in East Hampton, she’s curious about everything, loves being part of the action, and has a playful little spark that can brighten up any room. One minute she’s zooming around on a kitten-sized adventure, and the next she’s settling in for some well-deserved cuddles.

She may not be able to summon a dragon just yet, but she has already mastered the most important superpower of all - making everyone fall completely in love with her. Her battle cry? “Prepare to be adored!”
